thread:
Maya K: Quick design sync — we still see customers hit a wall on the Private setup network step. Instead of raw dumps, can we provide a short "what to try next" area + keyboard-first affordances?

Samir: +1. Also asked to consider a tiny KB shortcut that prefills host/port into a help article or ticket so customers can get started faster.

Jordan L: Current output example (ugh): ```
connect() failed: timeout
ERR_CODE=NET_TIMEOUT
stack: ...
```
Proposal: replace with a friendly banner: "Connectivity check: we couldn't reach your host." Show 2 quick actions and an "Advanced details" disclosure for logs.

Olivia: Accessibility checklist: 1) error banner uses role="alert" and aria-live="assertive"; 2) on failure focus moves to primary action; 3) disclosure toggles are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Also make copy/paste commands announce success.

Maya K: Copy suggestions: banner title = "Connectivity check"; body = "We couldn't reach your host. Try: verify hostname, open port 5678, and check outbound rules." Primary = "Run quick diagnostic" Secondary = "Open support ticket". Keep it short and prescriptive.

Samir: For diagnostics: prefer a centered modal (trap focus) that shows a one-line summary + downloadable .log. Modal should include a copyable test command e.g. `nc -vz 10.12.34.56 5678`. Do not render full logs inline.

Jordan L: Progressive disclosure: advanced details should show a one-line reason mapping (e.g., NET_TIMEOUT -> "Connection timed out; port may be blocked") and a small "Download raw logs" link. Keep stack traces out of the main flow.

Olivia: Keyboard flow: when the banner appears run `primaryButton.focus()` and set `aria-describedby` on the button pointing to the friendly message ID. Disclosure buttons need visible focus rings and be tabbable. Also add polite live region messages for non-critical toasts (e.g., "Diagnostic started").

Maya K: UX question: Should we persist wizard form state if users open diagnostics? I think yes — restore focus and show a tiny toast "Diagnostic result saved to session" on close.

Samir: Agree. We'll store interim form state in sessionStorage and restore on modal close. Also the KB shortcut: "Open help with prefilled host/port" should open a new tab with a support form prefilled (hashed host for privacy).

Jordan L: Mobile note: tooltips don't work well. Use inline chevrons that expand rows on touch. Keep commands short for small screens.

Olivia: A11y edge-case: Safari VoiceOver didn't announce the diagnostic-start toast in the last smoke test. Add a fallback: when starting a diagnostic also set focus to an offscreen sr-only live node with the message.

Support Bot: prereq-scan result: 2026-01-12T09:12:47Z. failing endpoint: 10.12.34.56:5678, observed RTT 31200ms. Raw logs available via presigned link (expires in 24h).

Maya K: Final microcopy pass: Shorten secondary CTA to "Contact support" and include a small hint under the banner: "You can change this port later in advanced settings."

Samir: I'll prototype the modal and the KB shortcut (prefill + hash). Will instrument events: `prereq.failure_shown`, `diagnostic.started`, `logs.downloaded`, `support.form_opened` (no raw IPs, only hashed).

Olivia: I'll update the Figma frames with the banner, disclosure, modal, and keyboard flow notes. I'll also run a11y checklist and document the Safari VO workaround.

Maya K: Great — let's aim to ship the spec early next week. :white_check_mark:
